page.overview:
Who is Xuttah?

" His name latedr meant "hello" or "blessings upon you" depending upon tone and vocal inflection, and would later constitue a prayer encompassed in a single word, as a devotee of the Bene Tleilax would prepare to die for the Great Belief.

Xuttah was also the name given to Ix in his honour during the temporary Tleilaxu take-over during Project Amal near the end of the Corrino Empire. Category:Prelude to Dune Category:Planets Category:Characters Category:Tleilaxu Masters Category:Bene Tleilax
